messages:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY BLOCKED] Attempted rollout rc5 -> prod. Reason: SBOM signing missing for image registry.redwood.com/runtime:rc5 (no cosign attached). Vulnerability scan: 1 transitive LOW severity CVE (CVE-2024-1234). Change window closes in ~2h. Options: pin digest for canary, request exception, or rollback. Pinging @release-manager @anne (security).

release-manager: ack. timeline: we need a decision in 45m or we miss the window and must postpone. What do we have for quick mitigations?

anne (security): quick context — signature absent for the pushed manifest. CVE is transitive via a third-party build-tool; severity LOW, no public exploit afaik. Compliance wants either: (1) signed SBOM attached before GA, or (2) timeboxed pin + monitored canary. Legal said low-severity can be exceptioned with audit trail.

jamal: can we pin to the last signed digest and run a canary subset? If the previous digest is still available we can carve out EU region for canary only. I can set up auto-rollback thresholds.

qa-eng: we can run the smoke + critical-path regression in the EU canary. Need ~20m to queue tests. Will also run the canary perf check.

release-manager: proposal: staggered carveout — deploy pinned digest to US+APAC as usual? Actually want to minimize blast: do EU-only canary with pinned digest for rc5 digest (if available) or pin to previous signed digest for EU canary while we require signed SBOM for full rollout. If digest missing, fallback is rollback. Thoughts?

anne (security): I like timeboxed pin for canary only. Condition: signed SBOM must be attached within 24h and we need a trace in the release notes about the exception and who approved it. If not, automatic rollback.

legal: confirm — record the exception: low severity, timeboxed 24h, audit note required. We need the release-manager to append the audit text to release-notes and tag the ticket.

jamal: I can configure the auto-rollback policy. Proposed thresholds: error rate >0.8% OR p50 latency regressions >30% over baseline for 5m window -> immediate rollback. I'll also restrict canary traffic to 5% of EU prod.

qa-eng: tests queued. Will update with results in ~25m.

release-manager: who can confirm the pinned digest exists and is signed? If not, we'll have to rollback. @jamal can you check image registry quickly?

jamal: checking registry now...

```bash
$ skopeo inspect docker://registry.redwood.com/runtime:rc5
Digest: sha256:deadbeefcafebabe1234567890abcdef
Signatures: none
SBOM: missing
```

jamal: digest exists but signatures missing. We can pin to that digest for a canary, but it won't be signed.

anne (security): ok with canary pin with the following controls: (a) timeboxed 24h, (b) signed SBOM delivered within window, (c) explicit audit note in release notes + security approval tag.

release-manager: decision: proceed with EU-only canary pinned to digest `sha256:deadbeefcafebabe1234567890abcdef`. If QA smoke passes and metrics stay within thresholds, we'll expand after SBOM signed. jamal, set rollout to 5% EU traffic and rollback policy as agreed. legal/anne: please confirm and I'll append exception text to release-notes.

anne (security): confirm. Approve timeboxed 24h pin for canary with monitoring and auto-rollback.

legal: confirm recorded. Please add ticket #REL-4821 to notes.

jamal: configuring rollout + auto-rollback now. Command to trigger carveout:```bash
deploybot carveout --region eu-west-1 --image "registry.redwood.com/runtime@sha256:deadbeefcafebabe1234567890abcdef" --traffic 5% --rollback-if "errors>0.8% or latency_p50>30%"```
Executing in 30s...

deploy-bot: carving out canary to eu-west-1 using pinned digest sha256:deadbeefcafebabe1234567890abcdef. Traffic: 5%. Auto-rollback rules: errors>0.8% or latency_p50>30% over baseline.

qa-eng: canary smoke started. First pass looks clean, no obvious 5xx spike.

jamal: monitoring hooks in place; alerting to #eng-oncall and #incidents on threshold breach.

release-manager: I'll append exception to release-notes: "Temporary canary pin to digest sha256:deadbeef... due to missing SBOM signature. Timeboxed 24h. Security and Legal approved. Ticket REL-4821."

alex: noted — product ok with this temp carveout, want updates at +1h and +12h.

deploy-bot: canary deployed. Current status: 5 instances, healthy=5, requests/min stable. Will post metrics snapshot in 10m.

qa-eng: smoke full pass completed, regression suite started. ETA 18m.

jamal: all good so far. I'll start the auto-escalation runbook if metrics deviate.

release-manager: thanks all — decision logged. If SBOM signed artifact arrives before 24h, we'll promote and clear the exception; otherwise automated rollback will occur at expiry.

deploy-bot: [LOG] canary-start ts=1716013390 status=running instances=5 health=5

(THREAD END)
